use_cases: Displaying article or blog post previews in a horizontally scrollable card layout
Showcasing portfolio items or featured content with stacked card visual effects
Creating an interactive news feed or content discovery interface
ai_summary: A dark-themed scrollable card component that displays article previews in a horizontal scrolling layout. Features smooth scroll animation via ReactLenis and visual card rotation effects for a dynamic, stacked appearance. Ideal for showcasing media content, blog posts, or portfolio items in an engaging scrollable interface.
